scroll.text: Sections 06–09 are one 3600px scroll block on the live site: four 900px full-bleed product panels, each with a hazy background built from its photo's colours and a client photo. Text column alternates right, left, right, left. Each photo has its own width and treatment so the scroll doesn't repeat: Vision School wide 860 + fade toward the text; Vision Camp 783 + fade; Field Operation narrow 640 + fade; Vision School Youth 783 vignette (feathered on every edge). Vision School and Field Operation also zoom slowly (24s, 1→1.08) on the live site.
